why_there_is_no_record: No benchmark result existed yet. The first one in this repository is benchmarks/compare/results.json, created by 51609be on 2026-09-28T04:02:28+08:00 -- a day later. The three scripts in benchmarks/ (bench_extraction.py, bench_inspect.py, bench_resident.py) print tables and do not commit their output.
no_numbers_were_fabricated_here: This entry is deliberately empty of numbers. A version with no measurement gets a file saying so, not a file with an estimate in it: an invented 0.9.0 figure would be indistinguishable from a measured one to anyone reading it in three months, which is the exact failure benchmarks/provenance.py exists to prevent.
what_would_close_this: Nothing. A measurement that was not taken cannot be recovered, and this milestone does not reconstruct it. Future versions get a record because perf_baseline.py and run_comparison.py now write an identity block on every run.
